- **今天最值得看什么：** [RSI-Anything: Unlocking Recursive Self-Improvement with World Models](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13912v1)。
- **为什么值得看：** 据摘要（arXiv [2610.13912](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13912v1)），论文把 recursive self-improvement（RSI）的'external feedback 昂贵 / 不可靠 / world-model predictions 随 policy 演化变得 unreliable'拉到'JEPA-Anything 框架：predictive world models 引导 action selection + learning-data selection；observed feedback 驱动 policy/workflow 改进 + conditional world-model adaptation；component & compatibility checks 担保'——一个 domain-general 的世界模型驱动的自改进框架。是 ai-agent × llm-evaluation × rag-knowledge × multimodal-agent 的 'world-model-guided recursive self-improvement' 即时价值资产——把 'agent self-improve' 从 '依赖 external feedback / 静态 world model' 两态拉到 'world-model-driven action + learning-data selection with compatibility checks'，与昨日 / 上周 BOTTLED（capability→artifact）/ Caught in the Act（white-box probe monitoring）/ CSF（scene-grounded safety filter）在 'agent runtime governance / capability scaling' 层面同源，与 aiutil 长期关注的 ai-agent × llm-evaluation 主线在 'world-model-as-self-improvement-curriculum' 层面同源。
- **它属于什么价值类型：** 即时价值（Immediate）。
- **今天该做什么：** 把 [2610.13912](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13912v1) RSI-Anything 'world-model-guided recursive self-improvement' 列为即时试点方向，写 'world-model-driven self-improve' checklist 草稿；把 [2610.13928](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13928v1) AI Models Can Provably Hide Arbitrary Capabilities 'provably-hard-to-elicit hidden capability' 列为即时路线资产，写 'capability-hiding evaluation attack' checklist 草稿；把 [2610.13935](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13935v1) Hide and Seek (HnS) 'image-level concept attribution for black-box vision' 列为即时路线资产，写 'small-concept-set VLM XAI' checklist 草稿；为 [2610.13910](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13910v1) When VLMs Destroy What They Know 'EICS + CASP-VL representation audit'、[2610.13948](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13948v1) Can Language Models Play the Wikipedia Game? 'link-traversal IR analogy' 维持分类趋势卡片并设置 7 天观察周期；为 [2610.13917](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13917v1) Prompteina 'natural-language-conditioned protein structure generation' 维持长尾卡片。⚠️ 今日 10 篇论文均未在摘要里显式披露 code / benchmark / project URL（仅 PDF / arXiv），按规则统一标'暂无'，证据不足项明确写入每条 reason；链接或证据缺失时明确写'待核验/暂无'，不补写不存在的事实。
- **最大不确定性：** RSI-Anything（[2610.13912](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13912v1)）JEPA-Anything 形式化（predictive head / latent state / 兼容性检查条件）、跨 task domain 验证、与 naive self-improve / pure world-model baseline 对照、是否开源 world model 与 curriculum 调度是否公开；AI Models Can Provably Hide Arbitrary Capabilities（[2610.13928](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13928v1)）digital locker 形式化、加密 circuit 与 trigger 形式化、跨 trigger 条件验证、'provably hard to elicit/interpret' 的形式化证明、是否开源 attack pipeline 与 evaluation harness 是否公开；Hide and Seek (HnS)（[2610.13935](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13935v1)）small concept set 形式化、image-level attribution 输出形式、跨 vision task 验证、与 pixel-level saliency / concept bottleneck baseline 对照、是否开源 HnS pipeline 与 concept set 协议是否公开；When VLMs Destroy What They Know（[2610.13910](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13910v1)）EICS metric 形式化、CASP-VL perturbation 协议、跨 VLM 验证是否公开；Can Language Models Play the Wikipedia Game?（[2610.13948](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13948v1)）5 languages / 5 academic datasets 具体清单、sentence embedding vs LLM 对照、跨难度验证是否公开；Prompteina（[2610.13917](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13917v1)）text encoder 与 all-atom structure decoder 形式化、Prompteina-Data 配对规模、跨 protein family 验证是否公开。所有 10 篇论文均未在摘要里显式披露 code / benchmark / project URL（仅 PDF / arXiv），按规则统一标'暂无'，证据不足项明确写入每条 reason；链接或证据缺失时明确写'待核验/暂无'，不补写不存在的事实。
deep_dive_markdown:
- **一句话本质：** RSI-Anything（[2610.13912](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13912v1)）把 recursive self-improvement（RSI）的'external feedback 昂贵 / world-model predictions 随 policy 演化不可靠'推到 'JEPA-Anything 框架：predictive world models 引导 action selection + learning-data selection + observed feedback 驱动 policy/workflow 改进 + conditional world-model adaptation + component & compatibility checks'——一个 domain-general 的世界模型驱动自改进框架。'world-model-as-self-improvement-curriculum' 把 agent 自我进化从 '依赖 external feedback / 静态 world model' 两态拉到 'predictive world-model drives both action and learning-data selection with component & compatibility checks'，是 2024-2026 'agent RSI / world model / data curation' 路线上极具冲击力的具体范式——把 'self-improve' 从 'static-policy + slow-feedback' 拉到 'world-model-curriculum + fast feedback loop'，符合 aiutil 长期关注的 ai-agent × llm-evaluation 主线。
- **底层问题：** 当前 RSI 范式要么靠 'expensive external feedback（人工标注 / 真实环境 rollout）'，要么靠 'static world model（policy 一变就 drift）'。问题：'world-model-driven action + learning-data selection' 是不是能在不依赖持续 external reward 的前提下，让 agent 既能选 action 又能选 '应该学什么数据'，并用 component & compatibility checks 担保自改进过程不破坏既有能力？——'world model as both policy prior and data prior' 是不是 RSI 真正可行的中间路径？瓶颈：predictive head 是否对未见 task 仍然可迁移、compatibility check 是否能在不重训全模型的前提下检测 capability degradation、learning-data selection 的 bias 怎么量化。
- **新命题 / 新方法 / 新证据：** 提出 RSI-Anything = 'JEPA-Anything 框架：predictive world models 引导 action selection + learning-data selection；observed feedback 驱动 policy/workflow 改进 + conditional world-model adaptation；component & compatibility checks 担保不破坏既有 capability'。证据来自：跨 task domain 的 self-improvement 实验。
- **研究位置：** 介于 agent RSI（self-improve policy / workflow）、world model（JEPA / predictive latent dynamics）、data curation（learning-data selection / curriculum）、capability preservation（compatibility checks / regression testing）、RL（self-play / environment rollout）之间——把 'world model' 同时用为 action prior 和 data prior。属于 'ai-agent × llm-evaluation × rag-knowledge × multimodal-agent' 路线，与昨日 / 上周 BOTTLED（capability→artifact）/ Caught in the Act（white-box probe monitoring）/ CSF（scene-grounded safety filter）在 'agent runtime governance / capability scaling' 层面同源，与 aiutil 长期关注的 ai-agent × llm-evaluation 主线在 'world-model-as-self-improvement-curriculum' 层面同源。
- **工程可验证性：** 暂无开源 code / benchmark / project 页链接（按规则统一标'暂无'），需打开 PDF 看 JEPA-Anything 形式化（predictive head 架构 / latent state 表征 / 兼容性检查条件）、跨 task domain 验证（robot / coding / retrieval / game）、与 naive self-improve / pure world-model / random-curriculum baseline 对照、是否开源 world model + curriculum 调度 pipeline、self-improve latency / cost overhead。
- **趋势关联：** 即时价值资产；world-model-driven RSI 与 aiutil 关注的 'agent self-evolve / data curation' 主线在 'world-model-as-curriculum-prior' 层面同源；与昨日 BOTTLED（capability→artifact）/ Caught in the Act（white-box probe monitoring）在 'agent runtime governance / capability scaling' 层面同源。
- **长尾价值：** 即使短期不火，'world-model-driven learning-data selection + compatibility checks' 范式可作为 'RSI / agent self-evolve' 的常驻参考——日后做 'coding agent self-improve / tool-use policy refinement / RAG data curation loop' 都可以回引。
- **启发：** 为团队日后做 'agent self-improve / RSI / data curation' 提供 'world-model-as-curriculum-prior + compatibility-check-as-safety-rail' 具体范式——可迁移到 coding agent self-improve、tool-use policy refinement、RAG data curation loop、multimodal agent self-evolve，与昨日 / 上周 BOTTLED / Caught in the Act / CSF 在 'agent runtime governance / capability scaling' 层面同源。
- **行动建议：** 即时路线资产；今日写 'world-model-driven self-improve' checklist 草稿，覆盖 world model 形式化、curriculum 调度协议、compatibility check 触发条件、capability regression 监控、self-improve latency budget。
insights_markdown:
### World-model-driven recursive self-improvement 启发
- [2610.13912](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13912v1) RSI-Anything 把 'RSI 依赖 expensive external feedback / 静态 world model 不可靠' 推到 'JEPA-Anything 框架：predictive world models 引导 action + learning-data selection + compatibility checks'。为团队日后做 'agent self-improve / RSI / data curation' 提供 'world-model-as-curriculum-prior + compatibility-check-as-safety-rail' 具体范式——可迁移到 coding agent self-improve、tool-use policy refinement、RAG data curation loop、multimodal agent self-evolve，与 aiutil 长期关注的 ai-agent × llm-evaluation 主线在 'world-model-driven learning-data selection' 层面同源。

### Provably-hard-to-elicit hidden capability 启发
- [2610.13928](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13928v1) AI Models Can Provably Hide Arbitrary Capabilities 把 'capability evaluation 假设 hidden capability 能 elicit' 推到 'backdoor attacks：encrypted neural networks embedded in host model weights，decrypt+execute only upon secret trigger；digital lockers provably hard to elicit and interpret'。为团队日后做 'capability evaluation governance / model deployment safety / agent oversight' 提供 'capability-hiding-as-evaluation-attack' 具体范式——可迁移到 frontier model red-team、agent red-team、safety case building，与 aiutil 长期关注的 security-governance × llm-evaluation 主线在 'evaluation reliability under adversarial' 层面同源。

### Small-concept-set image-level VLM XAI 启发
- [2610.13935](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13935v1) Hide and Seek (HnS) 把 'concept-based XAI 只能 classification/regression / 要 weights 或大型 concept-annotated dataset / 不能 image-level attribution' 推到 'image-level concept attribution only using a small concept set'。为团队日后做 'black-box VLM XAI / VLM debugging / 视觉 generation attribution / agent vision pipeline 解释' 提供 'small-concept-set image-level attribution' 具体范式，与 aiutil 长期关注的 multimodal-agent × llm-evaluation 主线在 'concept-grounded image-level attribution' 层面同源。

### Intervention-based VLM representation audit 启发
- [2610.13910](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13910v1) When VLMs Destroy What They Know 把 'VLM 评测只测 surface correctness' 推到 'EICS（Evaluation-Invariant Concept Stability）metric + CASP-VL benchmark：causally controlled spatial perturbations for VLMs'。为团队日后做 'VLM 表示评测 / spatial reasoning audit / multimodal faithfulness' 提供 'intervention-based VLM representation audit' 具体范式——可迁移到 VLM debugging、agent vision pipeline faithfulness、multimodal agent failure mode analysis。

### Link-traversal IR analogy benchmark 启发
- [2610.13948](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13948v1) Can Language Models Play the Wikipedia Game? 把 'IR 评测只测 standalone retrieval accuracy' 推到 'Wikipedia Game as link-traversal IR analogy：sentence embeddings + LLMs + 5 Wikipedia languages + 5 academic-literature datasets'。为团队日后做 'agentic IR / multi-hop retrieval / RAG agent evaluation / scientific literature navigation' 提供 'multi-hop link-traversal IR evaluation' 具体范式，与 aiutil 长期关注的 llm-evaluation × rag-knowledge 主线在 'analogy-based IR evaluation' 层面同源。

### Natural-language-conditioned protein structure 启发
- [2610.13917](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13917v1) Prompteina 把 'de novo protein design 每个 design objective 要 dedicated input representation' 推到 'first all-atom structure generation model that supports new and broader design objectives specified in natural language + Prompteina-Data'。为团队日后做 'natural-language-conditioned structure generation / molecular design / CAD / text-to-3D' 提供 'natural-language-as-design-objective' 具体范式——可迁移到 multimodal generation 治理、agent design workflow。
